== Course of events ==

The Cheshire Cat, in one of its most revealing moments, vanishes and reappears—a demonstration of its uncanny mastery over presence and absence. In this curious exhibition, the Cheshire Cat's supernatural ability to disappear and return again serves to confirm a truth both wondrous and strange: the baby had indeed become a pig before disappearing gradually into the mysterious depths of Wonderland. The Cheshire Cat's phantom comings and goings are bound intimately to this extraordinary transformation, as though the creature's own nature—its capacity to exist and cease existing at will—mirrors and authenticates the impossible metamorphosis and gradual vanishing of the infant.
